title: Chen2017 – Single-flicker online SSVEP BCI dataset
description: This dataset contains 32-channel EEG recorded with a BioSemi ActiveTwo system from 12 healthy participants using a single-flicker, spatially coded SSVEP brain-computer interface for spatial navigation. A single 15 Hz flickering square is shown at the screen center, and four non-flickering targets lie at the cardinal directions. Gaze direction produces distinct spatial topographies of the SSVEP response. Two sessions per subject are included: a structured training calibration session and an online adaptive BCI game session.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 32 channels with a BioSemi ActiveTwo system (CMS/DRL reference, biosemi32 montage). Session 0 (training) comprised 2 runs of 100 trials each (about 3.5 s per trial) recorded at 2048 Hz in XDF files. Session 1 (online) comprised variable-length trials from roughly 16 game rounds per subject, recorded at 512 Hz in MAT files. Participants gazed at one of four targets (north, east, west, south) while a single 15 Hz flicker was presented.
